name: Gadou Soushin
source:
Gadou Soushin lives for the pursuit of magic. One day he hears rumors of magical tomes in the possession of Boris Doreze.  

He comes up with a plan to kill him and take his items. What he obtained is clues about where to find the Key of Solomon.

In order to confirm its validity, he summons a familiar and decides to go to the manor where Boris lived.
